doc.name: echoloc — company intelligence
doc.instructions: echoloc company intelligence: technographics with direction of change (adopting / replacing / evaluating), hiring signals, and firmographics for 760,000+ companies, built from public job posts. Results that end with an '[anonymous preview …]' note are trimmed; results without that note are full data. This connection is not signed in. Without credentials tools return an anonymous preview (5 tool calls/day, trimmed results). Full data: sign in with an echoloc account via OAuth (OAuth-capable clients such as Claude prompt for it), or send an echoloc API key in the 'X-API-Key' header — free accounts get 100 requests/month; the key is on https://echoloc.ai/app/api after sign-up. Details: https://echoloc.ai/for-agents/

tools.name: search_companies_by_technologies
tools.title: Search companies by technologies
tools.description: Find companies using the given technologies, ranked by usage. Names are case-insensitive ('snowflake' == 'Snowflake'); 10,000+ technologies are tracked (use list_technologies to explore). match='any' needs at least one technology, 'all' needs every one.

tools.name: get_company_by_domain
tools.title: Get company profile by domain
tools.description: Resolve a company domain (e.g. 'walgreens.com') to its full profile: firmographics, hiring stats, and the technology stack with adoption context (using / adopting / replacing / evaluating). Matches the primary domain first, then known aliases (regional TLDs, legacy brands, subdomains).

domain.description: Company domain — primary or any known alias

tools.name: list_technologies
tools.title: List tracked technologies
tools.description: Catalog of all technologies in the dataset with per-technology company counts. sort='count' (most used first) or 'name'.
